say:1:1620833001:1.text: Welcome to The Rye! What can I get for you, new faces?
say:1:1620833001:1.source_cn: 几位似乎是新面孔啊。欢迎光临“黑麦”，请问要喝点什么？

say:3:1620833002:1.text: Hi, have you seen any of the Hypogean's minions around here?
say:3:1620833002:1.source_cn: 您好，您知道统治地上城的邪恶统领手下在哪里吗？

say:6:1620833004:1.text: Eh? My bad. I thought adventure stories let you be more direct... Guess I still have to talk my way around things like in real life.
say:6:1620833004:1.source_cn: 咦？抱歉，我以为在冒险故事里可以直接一点……唔，看来还...

say:8:1620833005:1.text: The character sheet did say we could use different skills to reach our goals, right?
say:8:1620833005:1.source_cn: 我记得角色卡上提到过，我们能够在冒险中运用不同的技能达...

say:10:1620833006:1.text: You praise Silven for being quick on the uptake, then explain the rules of the dice. Everyone is eager to test their skills on the bartender...
say:10:1620833006:1.source_cn: 你对休的理解力大加赞赏。接着，你向众人讲解了如何使用技...
say:10:1620833006:1.male: You praise Silven for being quick on the uptake, then explain the rules of the dice. Everyone is eager to test their skills on the bartender...
say:10:1620833006:1.female: You praise Silven for being quick on the uptake, then explain the rules of the dice. Everyone is eager to test their skills on the bartender...

say:12:1620833007:1.text: Um... Why are you all staring at me like that?
say:12:1620833007:1.source_cn: 呃……各位客人，你们这是要……

say:13:1620833008:1.text: Let me use the "Persuade" skill on the bartender! I'll win his trust first, then find out if he knows anything about the Hypogean.
say:13:1620833008:1.source_cn: 我要对酒保使用“说服”技能！让他对我们放下戒心，打探他...

say:15:1620833009:0.text: A roll of 12 or above is required to use the "Persuade" skill.
say:15:1620833009:0.source_cn: 行动回合开始。使用技能“说服”，需要掷出12点，方可判...

narration:18:1620833011:1.text: Silven rolled a 15. The action is successful.
narration:18:1620833011:1.source_cn: 投掷完毕，点数为15点，行动判定成功

say:20:1620833012:1.text: After acting clueless for a while, the bartender finally gives in. With a sigh, he sets down the shaker in his hand.
say:20:1620833012:1.source_cn: 酒保僵持了片刻。最后，他妥协地叹了口气，撂下了手中的雪克杯。

say:22:1620833013:1.text: You see, people from all walks of life come here. Some decent, some dodgy.
say:22:1620833013:1.source_cn: 我不知道你们是从哪里听来的消息。没错，“黑麦”是有不少...

say:23:1620833014:1.text: But we don't go blabbing about our patrons, and that's how we stay in business. I can't tell you anything. Please leave.
say:23:1620833014:1.source_cn: 但不透露客人的信息，也是我们能够在这里运营的依仗之一。...

say:25:1620833015:1.text: The bartender still won't budge... Maybe it's the wrong skill?
say:25:1620833015:1.source_cn: 技能判定成功了，但对方还是不愿意透露信息……是使用的技...

choice_prompt:26:1620833015.text: The bartender still won't budge... Maybe it's the wrong skill?
choice_prompt:26:1620833015.source_cn: 技能判定成功了，但对方还是不愿意透露信息……是使用的技能不合适吗？

say:27:1620833016:1.text: Alright, I'll try again. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I need your guidance!
say:27:1620833016:1.male: Alright, I'll try again. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I need your guidance!
say:27:1620833016:1.female: Alright, I'll try again. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I need your guidance!

choice_prompt:28:1620833016.text: Alright, I'll try again. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I need your guidance!
choice_prompt:28:1620833016.source_cn: 好，那就再试一次。<style=stress><player_name></style>，请指挥我们使用技能吧！
choice_prompt:28:1620833016.male: Alright, I'll try again. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I need your guidance!
choice_prompt:28:1620833016.female: Alright, I'll try again. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I need your guidance!

say:29:1620833017:0.text: What? Now? Uh... Let me throw the dice first!
say:29:1620833017:0.source_cn: 啊？现在吗？这……总之先投掷骰子试试吧！

say:31:1620833018:1.text: This is a difficult action. A roll of 12 or above is required to use the "Perform" skill.
say:31:1620833018:1.source_cn: 行动回合开始。困难行动，使用技能“表演”，需要掷出12...

narration:34:1620833020:1.text: Silven rolled a 13. The action is successful.
narration:34:1620833020:1.source_cn: 投掷完毕，点数为13点。行动判定困难成功

say:36:1620833021:1.text: The Dancing Poet performs a melancholic opera for the bartender.
say:36:1620833021:1.source_cn: 那么……舞蹈诗人在吧台前表演了一段哀伤的歌剧。

say:40:1620833023:0.text: Through mournful lyrics and sorrowful movements, the Dancing Poet portrays the people's suffering under the Hypogean's oppression, striking a chord with the bartender.
say:40:1620833023:0.source_cn: 用凄婉的唱词、悲伤的舞蹈，诗人绘声绘色地描述了地上城在...

say:42:1620833024:1.source_cn: 这就是技能吗？这……这效果未免也太强了吧？

say:44:1620833025:0.text: *Crying* I had no idea things were this bad outside! And yet I was still defending that Hypogean... I'm such a coward!
say:44:1620833025:0.source_cn: 呜……呜呜……没想到外面的世界竟然已经成了这样。可我竟...

say:45:1620833026:0.text: That minion you're looking for isn't here, but I do know a thing or two about the Hypogean. I'll tell you everything!
say:45:1620833026:0.source_cn: 虽然那个手下不在这里，但我多少也知道一些。我这就说……...

say:46:1620833048:2.text: If you head north from here, you'll reach a forest called the "Sinister Swamp". It's teeming with fearsome Hypofiends that even seasoned adventurers keep their distance.
say:46:1620833048:2.source_cn: 从这里出去往北走，有一片叫“恶沼森林”的密林，里面盘踞...

say:47:1620833049:1.text: The Hypogean dwells in the heart of that forest, guarded by its Hypofiend followers.
say:47:1620833049:1.source_cn: 恶魔就藏在那片森林的最深处，外围由追随它的魔物们重重把守着。

say:48:1620833050:1.text: If you dare, go ahead and face the lion in its den!
say:48:1620833050:1.source_cn: 你们要是还敢去的话，就去森林深处找它吧！

say:50:1620833051:1.text: The bartender told us to <style="highlight">head north</style>... but I don't see any forest up ahead.

choice_prompt:51:1620833051.text: The bartender told us to <style="highlight">head north</style>... but I don't see any forest up ahead.
choice_prompt:51:1620833051.source_cn: 酒保让我们<style=highlight>向北走</style>……不过，前面也没有什么森林啊？

say:53:1620833052:0.text: Hmm... I'm not great at imagining things, but I'll do my best. Let's <style="highlight">head north</style> and see what awaits us.
say:53:1620833052:0.source_cn: 唔……虽然不太明白，但我会努力想象的。我们先按照酒保指...

choice:51:0:1.source_cn: 当然了，我们还在图书馆啊

choice:51:1:2.source_cn: 要充分调动你的想象力！

say:56:1620833027:1.text: Should Pippa and I do something now? Magister Merlin, please tell us which skill to use!
say:56:1620833027:1.source_cn: 该我们出场了吗？梅林大人，请您来指挥我们使用技能吧！
say:56:1620833027:1.male: Should Pippa and I do something now? Magister Merlin, please tell us which skill to use!
say:56:1620833027:1.female: Should Pippa and I do something now? Magister Merlin, please tell us which skill to use!

choice_prompt:57:1620833027.female: Should Pippa and I do something now? Magister Merlin, please tell us which skill to use!

say:59:1620833028:1.text: Getting rough already? A-Alright! I'll use "Combat"!
say:59:1620833028:1.source_cn: 直接开打吗？好、好的！那么，我要使用“格斗”！

say:61:1620833029:1.text: A roll of 8 or above is required to use the "Combat" skill.
say:61:1620833029:1.source_cn: 行动回合开始。使用技能“格斗”，需要掷出8点，方可判断...

narration:64:1620833031:1.text: Pippa rolled a 20. The action is very successful!
narration:64:1620833031:1.source_cn: 投掷完毕，点数为20点。行动判定大成功！

say:66:1620833032:1.text: Wait, what? How do I even handle the story from here?!
say:66:1620833032:1.source_cn: 咦，这就大成功了？！那我要怎么编剧情？！

say:68:1620833033:1.text: Nice one, Pippa! Not even the ghosts can mess with your luck!
say:68:1620833033:1.source_cn: 不愧是皮帕，连怨灵的骰子都要为你的好运让步！

say:70:1620833034:1.text: Okay... here goes—The Berserker can't stand those who talk in riddles. Furious from being fooled time and again, the Berserker swings a devastating punch at the bartender!
say:70:1620833034:1.source_cn: 呃……呃呃呃，狂战士最恨那些说话说一半、故弄玄虚的谜语...

say:75:1620833036:1.text: The bartender lets out a cry of pain and collapses behind the bar...
say:75:1620833036:1.source_cn: 酒保发出了一声惨叫，歪倒在吧台后方不省人事……

say:77:1620833037:1.text: Oh no! ... Can we even get him to talk now?
say:77:1620833037:1.source_cn: 啊？！怎、怎么昏过去了……这样还能打探消息吗？

say:79:1620833038:1.text: Looks like a "very successful" action doesn't always lead to a good outcome. This game's more intricate and fun than I thought...
say:79:1620833038:1.source_cn: 原来如此……看来投掷出“大成功”也不全是好事。这个游戏...

say:80:1620833039:1.text: S-So sorry! I didn't mean to screw this up...
say:80:1620833039:1.source_cn: 对、对不起！我不是故意搞砸的……

choice_prompt:81:1620833039.text: S-So sorry! I didn't mean to screw this up...
choice_prompt:81:1620833039.source_cn: 对、对不起！我不是故意搞砸的……

say:83:1620833040:1.source_cn: 行动回合开始。困难行动，使用技能“治疗”，需要掷出15...

say:88:1620833043:1.source_cn: 酒保在你们的治疗下悠悠转醒。睁开眼看到你们后，他的脸上...

say:90:1620833044:0.text: W-What's wrong with you? You almost killed me just now! You're even worse than the Hypogean!
say:90:1620833044:0.source_cn: 你……你们到底要干什么，怎么上来就把人往死里打？！简直...

say:93:1620833046:1.text: Easy there, buddy. Your safety comes first, right? My friend here's got a short fuse, and you definitely don't want to take another hit from her...
say:93:1620833046:1.source_cn: “哎呀，酒保大哥，身体为重。我们这位狂战士朋友不知道轻...

say:95:1620833047:1.text: ... Fine, I'll talk. Look, that minion you're looking for isn't here, but I do know a thing or two about the Hypogean. I'll tell you everything.
say:95:1620833047:1.source_cn: ……说，我说就是了……恶魔的手下不在这里，但我也知道一...

choice:81:0:1.text: It's fine, we can fix him up.
choice:81:0:1.source_cn: 没关系，我们还有“治疗”技能
choice:81:0:1.male: It's fine, we can fix him up.
choice:81:0:1.female: It's fine, we can fix him up.
